data.name: Desired Future Conditions
data.description: Desired Future Conditions, PBC (DFC) is a U.S. public benefit corporation producing premium in-woods biochar and nature-based carbon solutions for working forests in North America. The company pyrolyzes clean biomass (forest slash, logging residues, and cull timber) in air curtain burners with built-in continuous biochar production features, producing high-carbon biochar for soil applications. DFC partners with landowners to generate both biochar product revenue and carbon removal credits.
